paired_differences_mae_z_vs_baseline.reading: three paired seeds on one task; both signs reported; no interval claimed from n = 3; not a verified causal effect

long_window_crop60.role: EXACT_INFORMATION_NULL: the raw input is cropped to its last 60 rows before the extractor

long_window_local_support_67.role: EXTRA_CONTEXT_67_SAMPLES (measured): NOT a null; the clamped core still reaches branch 5 + core 63 - 1 = 67 raw samples

crossing.reading: volume fixed by construction (one COMMON_INTERSECTION train origin set); every contrast taken within a seed; three seeds is three seeds

rule.declared: before any cell of this block was fitted
rule.statistic: improvement in validation MAE_z over the last 200 observed updates, i.e. val_mae(second-to-last event) - val_mae(last event), from each cell's own retained events
rule.verdict: an arm whose improvement exceeds the threshold in 2 or more of its 3 seeds is UNDERTRAINED_AT_CEILING, and no contrast involving it is read as a context or depth effect

budget_sensitivity.reading: a measurement of the budget's cost on the arms both blocks share, not a correction applied to any number; no arm of this block is adjusted by it and no cross-block difference is used as a contrast

train_constant.definition: mean of the train labels of the 28 d tier; computed on the common evaluation set at closure, no fit, no terminal
